[[Ice Tooth Cave]] is a desolate outpost in the northwestern most portion of the [[Northern Shiverpeaks]].

== Getting there ==
There are multiple ways to get to Ice Tooth Cave:
*Head north from [[the Frost Gate (outpost)|the Frost Gate]], which is the shortest path.
*Head west from [[Yak's Bend]].
*Head north from [[Beacon's Perch]].

==Notes==
*Complete exploration of this outpost contributes less than 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title.
*[[Running|Runners]] from [[Lion's Arch]] to [[Ascalon]] or vice-versa may charge half the price to Ice Tooth Cave, because it is the outpost closest to the middle of the entire run.
*Ice Tooth Cave is also the nearest outpost for those trying to skip over [[The Frost Gate]] mission.
*The portal to the cave is set into the cliff of the plateau, so you must approach from the northwest.
